summary: Inspired Entertainment filed an 8-K announcing that EVP and General Counsel Simona Camilleri will step down effective September 7, 2026, remaining on garden leave through December 31, 2026. Carys Damon, current Company Secretary and former General Counsel (2017–2024), will assume the roles. An employment agreement amendment dated August 12, 2026 formalizes the transition. The departure is planned and non-abrupt, with continuity via Damon's prior tenure. Advisors are not mentioned. What to watch: smooth legal-function handover and any subsequent operational impacts.
